name: Fel Haze grants Blood of Mannoroth full armor penetration (#788)
contract: Fel Haze 803903 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (misc=3, SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) with EffectBasePoints=99, DieSides=1, real amount 99+1=100. Its classmask (family 20, dword0 bit21) matches Blood of Mannoroth 802075 by SpellFamilyFlags. Blood of Mannoroth's own effect 0 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT) has EffectBasePoints=-1, DieSides=1 (a zero-value filler, real amount 0), so the generic Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers path raises its computed value from 0 to 100 (full penetration) once Fel Haze is learned.
